limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.

applicability.scope: Pre-run Ascend device-health, topology, occupancy and timing checks before a trusted baseline, multi-card run or graph capture, including after a killed job.
applicability.hardware: Ascend NPU card groups with topology and health visible through npu-smi.
applicability.input_contract: Intended card group, current topology/health and process occupancy, prior termination history and expected workload step timing.
applicability.produced_artifact: A pre-run health/occupancy and step-timing record, with recovery observations and a baseline-remeasurement requirement after a card-group change.
applicability.failure_modes: Health=OK can miss degraded post-kill timing; foreign processes, unwarmed clocks or comparing different card groups can contaminate the baseline.

recommendations: Read topology each session rather than hardcoding card numbers, then check health and foreign-process occupancy before the workload smoke check.
Use the short step-timing check to investigate post-kill degradation; record affected cards and timings instead of treating Health=OK as sufficient evidence.
Warm up operator measurements and remeasure the baseline after changing card groups; set only environment variables needed by the run.
